author: Zintenka
body:
I feel that Avicus would be better off being changed to Atlas.
Atlas is such a big update that it can't even be called an update; it's a META.

Avicus has had a reputation for lowering our server's player count and a lot of veterans leaving. Holding onto this name would just give people - in my opinion -  the feeling of the server being stagnant. This is psychology because... really, has Avicus been that successful?

No.

So for this reason, we should advertise ourselves as Atlas instead of Avicus. It sounds stronger and more firm, the upcoming features will severely boost the server's quality and it will make us seem like we're "New". If they see a server like this that is "New" yet has 30 - 70 players and people wonder why there aren't enough people joining despite the server's awesome features... they'll probably want to fix that. Maybe.

This is definitely a new chapter for this server, and when Atlas comes I'm not gonna call this server Avicus anymore. I'm calling it Atlas.

Things to do:
- Do NOT revert to 1.7/1.8. I'm even confused on why a topic like this was created in the first place. Funky stated that for how little percentage of the minecraft community actually plays 1.7 still isn't even worth it. We aren't badlion or Kohi.

Change comes, it's up to you whether you wish to adapt or be left behind. Also, the lag and hit detection was ATROCIOUS. This is one of the reasons why many players left in the first place. I don't even have this problem on 1.8/1.9.

Also, there will always be bowspammers, targeters and campers. Deal with it. To say that these actions deserve an infraction is one of the most retarded things I've ever heard.
If these are the case, why not ban swordspamming? Why not ban PVP altogether?

- Crowd sharing. Got friends who play minecraft or are new? Introduce them to the server and give them a tour. Tell your friends to tell their friends and so on and so forth. Twitter, Facebook and MAYBE instagram are good things for this.

- Youtubers. When we get more populous we could perhaps get someone that isn't an ass or an egotistical douche but still has a lot of people come on to the server and give it a try. Make sure it's a PVP youtuber who isn't too casual yet too competitive.

- Provide a practical staff and player guideline that also hits the grey area; everything isn't black and white. Whether it be rules of the server or ways to deal with an infraction having a rule-set like this will allow people to avoid making mistakes or finding loopholes to abuse the server.

replies.author: NotPineapple203
replies.body:
Might I point out the name of 1.8:

"The Bountiful Update"

In this update, more than 10 new blocks were added to the game. Andesite, Diorite, and Granite [plus polished] all give so many more different combinations to color palettes. In fact, I used polished andesite in one of my new maps. There are also blocks such as red sand/sandstone, prismarine blocks. and sea lanterns that I have yet to see be used, but see amazing potential with them. If we were to limit these blocks from the server JUST for a measly sliver of the server that refuses to switch, we would be limiting the potential for aesthetic in our maps.
_______________________________________________________________________________________

May I also point out why we play this game (Or at least most of us):

Because it is fun.

Humans do not like something that is easy and monotone. They want to be challenged. So things like hit rebuff and bowspam limitations challenge us. And if you are not ready to be challenged, then TOO BAD. Mojang has just released minecraft 1.10 after only 100 days of the release of minecraft 1.9. Obviously mojang has realized that they need to start working, and I'm sure it will be a while before they stop. And eventually the server will still run on 1.8/9, when minecraft 1.12 comes out, just because some people can't learn to control their trigger finger. And the only way we are going to stop this from happening is is these people stop complaining and deal with it. We play because it is a challenge not because it's easy.  And if there are people who play because it's easy and they complain about the update, how are they benefiting the server? Spamming the forums of reasons why to stay or revert? In my eyes that's not helping.

So if we want to start helping the server, tell the people who want the server to stay in 1.7/8 when minecraft is in 1.10 still with the rebuff, to stop being lazy [INSERT FOUR LETTER WORD OF CHOICE]s and learn to deal with it.

Thank You.
